title: Additional construction standards for cylindrical tanks exceeding 275 gallons (1041 L).
officialText:
Cylindrical tanks, including oval,
elongated oval, or round tanks, exceeding 275 gallons (1041 L) shall comply with the requirements of Sections 1305.14.2.1 thr ough
1305.14.2.3.
Exception: Such above-ground vertical tanks that are outside of buildings shall comply with Sections 1305.14.1 and 1305.14.5.
